Calculation check: V = 6.6/1.1 = 6 kV, and L = 20 km × 3 wires = 60 km, so I₁ = 1 + (2×60 − 100)/150 = 1 + 20/150 ≈ 1.133 A. Under 第17条第2項第二号ロ (attached PDF page 32), the result is rounded up and any value under 2 A is set to 2 A, so Ig = 2 A.

17-1表 (attached PDF page 32) gives 600/Ig for circuits joining high voltage (or special high voltage up to 35,000 V) to low voltage with a cutoff time of 1 second or less. So R ≤ 600/2 = 300 Ω, which is choice (4) and matches the fixed official answer 4.

Choice (1): 75 = 150/2, and 150/Ig applies under 「下記以外の場合」. Choice (2): 150 = 300/2, the coefficient for more than 1 second up to 2 seconds. Choice (5): 600 = 600/1 comes from taking Ig as 1 A. All three reasons are consistent with 17-1表.
